item.title: fix(gateway): models.list no longer returns empty while chat works (#…
item.summary: fix(gateway): models.list no longer returns empty while chat works (#123208) Gateway startup publishes the configured prepared-model owner with allowGatewaySubagentBinding, which is part of the owner key. Catalog readers (models.list, chat attachments, session create/patch) resolve flagless, and resolvePublishedOwner's configured-owner fallback required exact flag equality — so every read missed the published catalog, silently rebuilt a full live ephemeral catalog per request, lost the 750ms browse race, and returned {models: []} forever (view=all: ~73s). Treat an absent flag as a wildcard in the fallback, mirroring the adjacent workspaceDir/env/runtimePluginSelections clauses; a reader that explicitly demands binding still never receives a non-binding owner. Delete the chat-metadata dual-lookup workaround for the same seam.
